description: This plugin makes it possible to monitor or operate a single MTP-compliant Process Equipment Assembly over OPC UA.
ASP.NET Core helpers for SheetStream: return a streamed .xlsx download from a minimal API or controller in one line, with flat memory and no synchronous I/O.

Client for the Nexra platform API: integrations, flows, runs, connections, triggers, reconciliation, approvals and signed event webhooks. Typed from the OpenAPI document, with retries, typed errors, cursor pages and webhook signature checks.
.NET SDK for mail-martinsil, a Resend-compatible email API on Amazon SES.
MCP server and command line for reverse engineering .NET assemblies and native PE, ELF and Mach-O binaries: decompile, search, compare builds, patch and save. Nothing is executed.
